text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins—the prime time<n>for
Umamusume to improve their<n>skills.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
According to Taiki Shuttle, summer<n>camp is an
extreme affair, with<n>grueling training during the day
and<n>pillow fights at night.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She talks big, convinced she'll make<n>history as the
first sprinter to become<n>Umamusume of the Year.
However,<n>her words are far from empty.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us vow to work hand in<n>hand to make
our stay at the camp a<n>success.
